_comment: The acid parting vessel's build (#931, #711): each stage after the iron frame and its materials, from AcidParting/README.md's stage table and the rig's build.stages, in order; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema); README 'Ore machines: what they share'. The brickwork is any one fired brick (oneType: the first sets the vessel's brick type; the codes are the rig's bricks.types, red first for the creative shortcut); the sand bath's sand any sand; the vessel any fired crucible. A click puts in as many of the held stack as the stage still needs. The copper plate in the tub is the wearing part (requires copper), hung by right-click once the vessel is built and worn by the silver it throws down (uses: silver units, a plate's 200 units of copper taking the place of silver at 63.5 to 2 x 107.9 by weight, so 680). The outlet's cap and the damper are not stages (AcidParting/Game/BEAcidParting.cs).
